answer: Make every vote cross a bridge it must build itself: to attest, an identity completes a unique timed task whose solution binds to its own history — each output stamped like ferrous metal with a maker's mark. A clone voyage buys nothing: every duplicate still owes one fresh, distinct proof before its voice counts, and similarity checks void copied work, so a farm's cost scales one-for-one with its size while honest agents pay only what they already spend.
